name: Witchbane's orb
description: A magical ward against curses created by the widow, used as a lure in Odric's trap.

timeline.summary: At midnight Odric and Grete lie in wait by a witchbane's orb baited with the widow's blood, and Odric recalls that her corpse showed no sign of werewolf violence.
timeline.quote: There was no evidence she'd been killed by a werewolf attack
